overview.headline: World climate zones grouped by temperature, precipitation and latitude

keyPoints.point: Students learn that climate is the average weather measured over 30 year intervals influenced by tilt and distribution.
keyPoints.quote: The climate is the reoccurring average weather found in any particular place, measured over 30 year intervals.

keyPoints.point: Tropical climates have all months with average temperatures greater than 64°F and annual precipitation greater than 59 inches.
keyPoints.quote: In these climates, all months have average temperatures greater than 64°F (18°C) and annual precipitation greater than 59".

keyPoints.point: Dry climates are defined where potential evaporation and transpiration exceed precipitation and conditions are very dry.
keyPoints.quote: potential evaporation and transpiration exceed precipitation

keyPoints.point: Polar climates have year-round cold temperatures and the warmest month stays below 50°F on northern coasts and Greenland and Antarctica.
keyPoints.quote: Polar climates have year-round cold temperatures, with the warmest month less than 50°F (10°C).

keyTerms.gloss: long term average weather for a place measured over 30 year intervals
keyTerms.quote: The climate is the reoccurring average weather found in any particular place, measured over 30 year intervals.

keyTerms.gloss: moist zone near the equator that extends north and south where every month stays warm
keyTerms.quote: Moist tropical climates extend north and south from the equator to about 15° to 25° latitude.

keyTerms.gloss: Climates where evaporation exceeds precipitation and conditions are very dry
cold temperatures with warmest month below 50°F and year round cold on northern coasts
keyTerms.quote: Polar climates have year-round cold temperatures, with the warmest month less than 50°F (10°C).

keyTerms.gloss: mountainous zone where rapid elevation changes cause rapid climatic changes over short distances
keyTerms.quote: Highland climates occur in mountainous terrain where rapid elevation changes cause rapid climatic changes over short distances.

keyTerms.gloss: main winter weather feature that brings storms in mid-latitude regions
keyTerms.quote: During the winter, the main weather feature is the mid-latitude cyclone.
